design: A pre-registered 2^(5-1) resolution-V screen with negative generator Model = -(Prompt x Data x Tool x Workflow). The negative sign preserves resolution V while placing both the all-low baseline and the all-high P/D/T/W core loop in the scratch half-fraction.

prompt.low: generic finite-table instruction with no mechanism wording
prompt.high: structured residual-evidence instruction with an explicit non-causal interpretation boundary

data.low: random acquisition only from the pre-materialized label-blind tree
data.high: random-or-geometry-coverage acquisition from the same label-blind tree with source-index provenance

tool.low: raw validation-metric receipt; no typed residual-class tool
tool.high: registered validation_residual_v1 diagnostic with a typed finite action interface

workflow.low: static five-stage schedule fixed before the first training round
workflow.high: five-stage observation -> finite decision -> retraining workflow, with no test feedback

model.high: pinned foundation adaptation; the binary factorial screen uses naive full fine-tuning, while LoRA, freeze-5, and replay form a separately paired model-method extension

execution_contract.unit: Each factorial cell is a matched four-arm five-round episode on one development molecule and seed. The four policy arms are controls inside a cell, not substitutes for the five axes.

core_alignment.rationale: Both are runnable scratch cells under the negative generator and define the clearest baseline-to-full-loop contrast.

execution_contract.primary_screening_response: For each cell, estimate the outer-generated policy effect against its matched information-removed control using final independent error, five-round validation area-under-curve, labels-to-threshold, and cumulative wall time.
execution_contract.promotion_rule: Only development results choose a promotion configuration. Toluene remains a policy holdout and cannot select a cell or update a policy.
execution_contract.model_high_admission: Require a pinned foundation artifact hash, a method-specific CPU dry run, the same rMD17 split and evaluator, E0s=estimated unless explicit same-level isolated-atom DFT values are admitted, and a separately audited replay source for multihead replay.
